chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from Ibn Sama'ah from Al-Husayn ibn Hashim and Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said:

I asked him about the pregnant woman when her husband divorces her, and she gives birth to a miscarriage that is complete or incomplete, or she gives birth to a lump. He said: 'Everything she gives birth to, if it is evident that it is a pregnancy, complete or incomplete, then her waiting period has ended, even if it was a lump.'

key_terms.مُضْغَةً: A lump or chewed-like substance, referring to an early stage of fetal development

ai.seo_question: When does a pregnant woman's waiting period end if she miscarries or gives birth to an incomplete fetus after divorce?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the 'iddah of a divorced pregnant woman concludes immediately upon the expulsion of any recognizable fetal form, whether fully developed or merely a 'mudghah' (chewed-like lump), reflecting the Shia juristic principle that birth terminates the waiting period regardless of viability. This ruling is derived from the Quranic verse 65:4, which specifies 'their term is until they give birth,' and is supported by Shia scholars who emphasize the physical evidence of delivery over gestational age. The inclusion of 'mudghah' highlights the flexibility in recognizing early stages of pregnancy as sufficient for ending the 'iddah.

en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Sama’at, from Al Husayn Bin Hashim and Muhammad Bin Ziyad, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the pregnant woman when her husband divorces her, so she places a miscarried, complete or incomplete, or places a lump’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Everything she places (gives birth to) proves that she was pregnant, complete or incomplete, so she has fulfilled her waiting period, even if it was a lump’.
en.sarwar: 9. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from ibn Sama‘ah from al-Husayn ibn al-FIashim and Muhammad ibn Ziyad from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajja] who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about the case of a woman who is pregnant: if her husband divorces her and she gives birth prematurely or by abortion or it is just a lump. He (the Imam) said, ‘Whatever she gives birth to shows that she was pregnant, complete or not. Her waiting period is complete even if it is a lump.”’
